names.note: Read out of «Св. Плакила царица.» in this folder’s Serbian citation.

death.note: About 386, azbyka.ru, after Philaret of Chernigov; Gregory of Nyssa spoke her funeral oration. saint.gr says only wife of Theodosius the Great. The Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs: „Упокојила се мирно око 400. год.“; the interval holds both.
